name: Scroll-to-top button appears after scrolling and returns to top
description: After scrolling more than 400px down, a floating scroll-to-top button must appear in the bottom-right corner; clicking it must bring the page back to the top so the hero is visible again.

planSteps.description: Scroll down the page until the footer area is visible
A circular scroll-to-top button with an up arrow is visible fixed at the bottom-right corner of the viewport
The page has scrolled back to the top and the hero headline 'Sulap Foto Jadi Stiker' is visible again at the top of the viewport
